prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game UI bitmap, exactly one empty control background, 512x192 pixels wide (8:3). Matte non-pixel hand-painted parchment from a medieval ledger, warm delicate linework, very restrained clean ivory palette #F2E7D2 matching the supplied existing parchment panel. Front-facing orthographic, no perspective. Single rounded rectangular silhouette flush to canvas bounds, tiny radius about 12 source pixels, actual transparency only at corner cutouts, no exterior padding. Nine-slice fixed borders 48px left/right/top/bottom: all edge structure must finish well within 48px; almost uniform central 416x96 text area. Subtle paper wear only outer 8px, no grain or spots in center. Flat horizontal/vertical edge bands, no decorative features crossing slicing boundaries. It will display at 0.5 scale and heights 34-48px, so use clean legible broad edge relief rather than fine detail. NO text, digits, symbols, arrows, writing, watermark, glow, drop shadow, external shadow, cast shadow, background, ornate frame, heavy stains, shiny highlights. NORMAL BUTTON: pale ivory #F2E7D2 raised paper face, narrow soft light top/left bevel and warm thin darker lower edge imply a very slightly raised unpressed sheet. Quiet flat center for dark #2A2118 text.
